objective: Build a command-line application that watches a local folder for incoming files and uploads them to https://dash.lumabooth.com/event/-P1Y143qUTagjT1hDguA/upload.
definitionOfDone: The .NET 8 CLI recursively processes an initial backlog and newly arriving stable files.
Files are streamed through the verified LumaBooth PUT and event-registration POST contract.
Bearer credentials are supplied externally, never logged or persisted, and only sent to allowlisted hosts.
Durable atomic state prevents routine duplicate uploads and resumes safely after restart.
Retries, reconciliation, corrupt-state handling, and graceful shutdown are covered by automated tests.
Release restore, build, test, and publish succeed.
Independent test, security, code review, QA, and final judgment gates approve.
